stories.title: Montreal mayor apologizes for Kraft Dinner comment amid tax hike backlash
stories.summary: A Kraft Dinner analogy from Montreal’s mayor is fuelling backlash as residents face a nearly 10 per cent property tax hike and growing affordability pressures.

stories.title: The new Quebec college of physicians president wants to reform the code of ethics
stories.summary: Nathalie Saad says she wants to incorporate new technologies into the code, including telehealth, as well as artificial intelligence and other digital tools.

stories.title: Third former Montreal police officer charged in misconduct investigation
stories.summary: Another former Montreal police officer has been arrested as part of an ongoing investigation into allegations of racist and discriminatory acts.

stories.title: Quebec man, one of Canada’s most wanted fugitives, arrested in Ontario
stories.summary: A 19-year-old Quebec man who was one of Canada’s most wanted fugitives has been arrested. Sûreté du Québec said Tuesday Ayoub Mohamed was arrested Monday by police in London, Ont.

stories.title: Lack of snow forces cancellation of World Cup giant slalom races in Quebec
stories.summary: Two women's World Cup giant slalom races scheduled in Mont-Tremblant, Que., have been cancelled due to a lack of snow, the International Ski and Snowboard Federation says.

stories.title: Quebec appeals ruling reinstating oath to King as legislature opening looms
stories.summary: Quebec opposition leaders are urging Premier Paul St-Pierre Plamondon not to delay opening the parliamentary session over the oath to the King.

stories.title: Transport minister defends new land seizure powers proposed for high-speed rail
stories.summary: Transport Minister Steven MacKinnon is pushing back against criticism of new land seizure powers proposed for a high-speed rail project between Toronto and Quebec City.

stories.title: Montreal mayor announces 10% tax hike to address infrastructure ‘backlog’
stories.summary: Montreal homeowners will pay an average $515 more next year as the city raises property taxes by 9.8% to fund aging infrastructure.

stories.title: Call of the Wilde: Montreal Canadiens fall to the Los Angeles Kings in Dylan Larkin’s debut
stories.summary: Larkin didn't waste any time in his first game Monday night at home against the Los Angeles Kings. Larkin was solid, but the Canadiens played the Berlin Wall falling 2-1.

stories.title: Montreal touts aerospace, AI in bid to host NATO defence bank
stories.summary: The Defence, Security and Resilience Bank is expected to launch next year with about 50 employees, growing to as many as 700 within a decade.
